question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A spear used for hunting large fish
solution: The correct answer is '**Harpoon**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Harpoon**'. • It means 'a long thin weapon with a sharp pointed end and a rope tied to it that is used to catch large sea animals (whales)'. (व्‍हेल मछलियों के शिकार का भाला; मछभाला) • *Example: It is taken with the **harpoon** and its oil is one of the commercial products of the Amazon valley.* **Correct Answer:__** *Harpoon.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Lance**: a long weapon with a wooden shaft and a pointed steel head, formerly used by a horseman in charging. (एक लकड़ी के शाफ्ट और एक नुकीले स्टील के सिर के साथ एक लंबा हथियार, जिसे पहले घुड़सवार द्वारा चार्ज करने में इस्तेमाल किया जाता था।) • **Dagger**: a type of knife used as a weapon, especially in past times. (कटार, दुधारी छुरा, विशेषतः अतीत काल में प्रयुक्त) • **Sword**: a long, very sharp metal weapon, like a large knife. (तलवार, कटार) 35:T609, The correct answer is '**become**'.
